cases.name: name_full_and_parts
cases.notes: The whole folded name and every part of >= 3 characters, as whole words of a line.

cases.name: name_short_parts_ignored
cases.notes: 'K' and 'R' are too short: 'Vitamin K 1.2 mg' is not redacted, 'Menon ...' is.

cases.name: phone_number_variants
cases.notes: +91, (022) 2345-6789, a bare 10-digit run and any other 7..15 digit run (the invoice number too - the rule errs towards over-redaction) match; an ISO or a dotted numeric date and a 6-digit PIN do not. blocks_json is given as a string here.

cases.name: phone_spares_lab_result_lines
cases.notes: Result lines keep their values and ranges: a §13 lab row, a number + units.json unit and a bare printed range are never phone matches. A phone label always wins, even on a line that also carries a unit; a bare 10-digit id line and an unlabelled 8-digit run are still redacted.

cases.name: lab_result_lines_all_classes
cases.notes: The same page with every class: the UHID line is caught by patient_id as well, the result lines stay readable.

cases.name: phone_labels_and_negatives
cases.notes: 'Mobile:', 'Contact' and 'Ph No' are labels; 'Photometry' is not.

cases.name: other_ids_mixed_alnum
cases.notes: A word of >= 6 characters mixing letters and digits on a line that carries an id label.

cases.name: overlapping_classes
cases.notes: One line can carry several classes; they are listed in REDACTION_CLASSES order.

cases.name: page_without_blocks_is_excluded
cases.notes: Page 1 has no blocks_json: excluded with the §34 warning; page 2 is still redactable.
